nom: L'Oréal Revitalift Triple Power Age-Defying Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their own skin as sensitive say this serum, unlike other anti-aging products they have tried, does not burn or sting, and they report no irritation despite the active ingredients.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s use this serum against fine lines, loss of firmness and sun spots, most reporting a gradual softening of lines and firmer, more even-toned skin with consistent use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, especially those in their 40s to 60s, report softer-looking fine lines and improved firmness within a few weeks of twice-daily use, though several others say they saw no visible change in their wrinkles even after a month or more of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and non-greasy, leaving skin feeling plumper and softer, though one reviewer noted it made her skin a touch dry during winter.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report their dark spots or discoloration faded and their skin tone became more even with continued use, though one long-time user in her 60s said her sun spots remained despite other visible improvements.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer developed a new pimple most mornings along with red, rash-like patches while using the serum, though she suspected this was linked to it surfacing her dark spots; several other reviewers, including sensitive-skin users, report no breakouts or irritation at all.

extraits.texte: Amazing product, best used alone. It's not very absorbing and gets sticky on my pores. I think it lacked appeal for my skin tone or fine lines.

I received this item free for my honest review. This serum has a nice milky texture in an easy to use dropper bottle. The scent is slight but pleasant. It contains Tri-peptides, vitamin C, and hyaluronic acid to reduce wrinkles and brighten skin, yet I have yet to see this after a month of morning and night use. It states that it won't clog pores, yet I've had a new pimple on my face every morning, including small, rash patches, and large circular red areas on my cheeks. I attribute that to the brightening, as I do have dark spots in those larger rash areas. Perhaps it was beginning to do its brightening work, pulling the dark spots to the surface. Perhaps more use will show a better outcome.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used every night for approximately 2 months and seen a noticeable difference with my age spots and texture . Not a heavy serum but absorbed very well. No heavy scent!

I've been using the L'Oréal Revitalift Tri-Peptides Age-Defying Serum for the past few weeks, and as a 40-year-old woman who's starting to notice those fine lines around my eyes and mouth, I have to say I'm impressed. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. Within the first week, my skin felt noticeably smoother and more hydrated. After about a month, I've seen a subtle but real improvement in firmness, especially around my jawline. My makeup also applies more evenly now because my skin feels plumper and less textured. The dropper bottle makes it easy to control the amount I use, and a little goes a long way, so the product lasts. The scent is mild and pleasant, which is important for me because I'm sensitive to overpowering fragrances. Is it a miracle in a bottle? No — nothing erases years overnight — but it's definitely helped my skin look fresher and more rested, and for the price, it's worth keeping in my daily routine. I'd recommend it to anyone looking to start or maintain an anti-aging skincare regimen without breaking the bank.

extraits.titre: Over time, this serum minimizes and slows down aging!
extraits.texte: In recently turning 61, I am thrilled to discover products that slow down my aging skin. I received this product gratis in exchange for an honest review. I can attest it has lightened darker patches on my cheeks, softened eye and lip wrinkles, while plumping up my skin. The triple power of Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, and Tri-Peptides do the job. The faint scent is pleasant, and a little product goes a long way. The serum dropper is easy to use with no greasy film. My skin is sensitive, yet not irritated by this product. I'll continue to use this product and add it to my ongoing skincare regimen.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Side by side comparison with 1 application. I look so old without this. Embarrassing to put the before pic. Makes skin look much better after just one application. I have very sensitive skin and don't like to use anti aging products because they usually burn or sting, thus product doesn't burn or sting. Feels like it tightens the skin a few minutes after applying it.

I am a woman of a certain age, 63 years, who needs the help of this excellent serum very badly. I have fine lines. I have deep lines. I have saggy skin. I have sun spots out the wazoo. I have been using this serum consistently for about 6 weeks and I really feel my fines lines are reduced, my deep lines are not as deep and my skin is definitely firmer. My sun spots are still there but that's what concealer is for, right? I am a big fan of this product now and I will continue to use it. You should too.
